card.name: Small words before delay or risk phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, have, a, an, can, the) right before a word about timing, delay, or something that might happen unnoticed. Seen in infection, exposure and risk sentences.

modes.label: Risk of starting drug
modes.description: The word "of" after "minimize the risk" before a verb like initiating.
modes.example: care should be taken to minimize the risk<< of>> initiating or continuing VOCABRIA before confirming

modes.label: Helper before a delay or missed event
modes.description: Helper words like have, a, an or can before words such as delay, incubation period, or been in contact.
modes.example: and there's often<< a>> delay in case reporting.

modes.label: Time to onset
modes.description: A small word before a time-course noun in a disease sentence.
modes.example: however,<< the>> time to onset is more variable and can
